svg.title: Mockup 02: Health, what needs you (event crew)
svg.text: 02 · Health: what needs you, in plain words (event crew)
The built Health page grows an incident band: each problem of this event as a card with what it means, who was told, and the next step.
Use case: during the event, a crew member sees at a glance what is wrong in their event and acts on it (desk at 1280 px, phone at 390 px)
A · Health at 1280 px: two problems need the crew, one is muted, three fixed themselves
oldest first; a change of state never moves a card
No word from it for 3 min, since 21:29.
Screen 1 still shows the Main hall zone.
Posts and commands are late, not lost.
4 of 5 online · Main hall screen 2 dark
Lobby screen was stuck 60 s; reloaded
Food reminders late 2 min; caught up

g.text: No word from it for 3 min.

svg.text: Health keeps its place and name (the menu's
"Health 1 down" note is built, #478). It gains
History and Alert settings beside Now
Count tiles say what matters: what needs
you, what is muted, what fixed itself. The
platform is one coarse word for event crew
An incident card: state, what it means in
words, what still works, and who was told.
Cards follow amendment 3: an 18 rem card
grid; two cards keep their width at the left
Ack stops the reminders and tells the others
someone is on it; Mute silences one subject
for a set time, never for ever (U5, U6).
The event's own parts, as a table: compared
by state and words. Each row links to the
Related panels sit in a band below the
collection, never in a column beside it
